name: Range
description: A slider for one value, or two thumbs for a from–to range. Each thumb is a native input type=range laid over the drawn track, so keyboard, touch and screen readers get the platform slider.

props.name: value
props.description: The value: a number, or [from, to] with dual. Livewire binds it with wire:model, Vue with v-model.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value of an uncontrolled range: a number, or [from, to] with dual.

props.name: dual
props.description: Two thumbs for a from–to range. The value is [from, to] and the thumbs can't cross.

props.name: showValue
props.description: When the value bubble above a thumb shows. Emitted as data-show-value.

props.name: format
props.description: How a value reads in the bubble, the marks and aria-valuetext: a template where {value} is the number, such as {value} km or ${value}k.

props.name: marks
props.description: Labels under the track: [{ value, label }], placed at their values.

props.name: color
props.description: The fill and thumb edge. Emitted as data-color.

props.name: label
props.description: The visible label, linked to the (first) thumb.

props.name: hint
props.description: Help text under the track, linked with aria-describedby.

props.name: error
props.description: Validation message. Marks the field invalid and is linked with aria-describedby.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the field invalid without a message. Emitted as data-invalid.

props.name: thumbLabels
props.description: With dual, the names added to the label for each thumb. Livewire translates the defaults.

props.name: errorField
props.description: The validation key to read from $errors. Defaults to the wire:model name.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { track: '…', thumb: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The field: label, track, marks, hint and error. Its inline --apui-_from and --apui-_to place the fill and thumbs.

parts.name: label
parts.description: The visible label, for the (first) thumb.

parts.name: track
parts.description: The rail the fill and thumbs sit on.

parts.name: fill
parts.description: The filled span: from the start (or the from thumb) to the value.

parts.name: control
parts.description: A native input type=range per thumb, transparent over the track. Attributes other than class land on it (on both with dual).

parts.name: thumb
parts.description: The drawn thumb (aria-hidden), positioned at its value.

parts.name: bubble
parts.description: The value above a thumb, per showValue.

parts.name: mark
parts.description: One label, placed at its value.

events.name: value-change
events.description: The value changed: a number, or [from, to] with dual.

keyboard.action: Increases the value by step. ArrowRight follows text direction, so it decreases in RTL.
Decreases the value by step. ArrowLeft follows text direction, so it increases in RTL.
Changes the value by a larger step.

requirements: Each thumb is a native input type=range, so the platform supplies role=slider, the keys and touch.
aria-valuetext carries the formatted value (format), such as $200k.
With dual, each thumb is named by the label plus its thumb label (Minimum, Maximum), and the thumbs can't cross.
The fill and thumbs follow text direction: under RTL the track fills from the right.
The thumb is 18px (14px small) with a 24px hit area.
Visible focus ring on the thumb while its input has :focus-visible.
Disabled uses --apui-text-disabled for the fill and edge, never opacity alone.
